notes.title: 250509 Update
notes.notes:
We hope you’re enjoying Tempopo! With this update have a new feature to share with you: [b]Hint Assist Mode![/b] If you've enjoyed the hints that Hana can give you, turn this mode on and she’ll always show you the next spot to place instructions, to help you keep puzzling to rescue those musical flowers. 

This is particularly helpful for younger players, but you might find yourself needing to turn it on in some of the Winter or Challenge levels as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/1e77907a028b9f57070c45704cf0daf0afb4d483.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/1d73a8afd207060d1e9bd48e13e7def2857a983e.jpg[/img]

We've managed to squash a few tiny bugs as well, here's the full list of patch notes for you!

FEATURE
[list]
[*] Added Hint Assist Mode that automatically shows the next hint after placing an instruction
[/list]

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Melody Garden flowers will no longer occasionally play their notes out of sync with the column highlighting
[*] Gallery images won't behave strangely in fullscreen mode if only one image was unlocked
[*] Linux controller icons would sometimes show up without a controller plugged in, but not anymore!
[/list]

notes.title: 250420 update
notes.notes:
Yesterday we believed we had fixed a rare game logic issue some users had encountered (Block Tempopo could get stuck in place, Uplift Tempopo lifting duration could be halved, Tempopo could turn invisible, and sounds could play at the wrong time), but after releasing the new build, we discovered the underlying cause. 

We believe it is now (really) fixed!

notes.title: Tempopo is out now! 🌷
notes.notes:
It’s time, it’s time!

Tempopo is out now on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=w1mkkTm6IDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Tempopo is a delightful and chaotic puzzle game, where you’ll instruct the Tempopo in how best to collect musical flowers to rebuild Hana’s lost garden. It’ll take you through four seasons of puzzles, collecting five different types of flowers, and you’ll have to avoid enemies like Chompers and Spike Bushes to solve these island puzzles and rescue the flowers. Hana will supervise and offer hints if you want them, and once you collect all the flowers within a season, lay them out in her garden, and she’ll conduct a tune for you. 

You can pick between [b]Puzzle Mode[/b], where you’ll have to figure out what instruction to give as well as where to place it, and [b]Adventure Mode[/b], which helps you out by letting you know which squares are viable spots (this is great for younger players too!)

And of course, that’s not all—we’ve also created a [b]Melody Garden[/b] where you can compose your own tunes, (or recreate your favourites!), additional [b]Challenge Levels[/b] for those puzzle fiends among you, and even a [b]Creative Mode[/b], where you can choose any number of instructions to give your Tempopo to solve a level. If you lose track of which Tempopo is which, remember that you can give them accessories in the Options menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/e239e378c912bedcb45361b5c5435d567f2674af.jpg[/img]
Tempopo is a real labor of love for the Witch Beam team, and we’ve been working at it for quite some time (that’s how it ended up as a cameo in Unpacking!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/d242f2f13442b8fe26ba6c990b48673ebf6c2906.jpg[/img]

We’re so glad that it’s out in the world now, and you can experience everything it has to offer. We love it very much.

As we’re a small studio, we appreciate all the love you can share, so if you feel inspired:
[list]
[*] Spread the word to your friends, family, and favorite streamers
[*] Leave a review
[*] Share the news on social media
[/list]
(of course, there’s no obligation there! We appreciate you regardless!)

And please, if you compose a tune in the Melody Garden, please tag us on social media ([url=https://bsky.app/profile/tempopogame.com]Bluesky[/url],  [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tempopogame]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://x.com/tempopogame]Twitter[/url]) as we’d love to see it! 

But now we’ll leave you to it—go and play Tempopo!

Cheers,

Emily and the Witch Beam team

notes.title: Tempopo is coming out in ONE WEEK
notes.notes:
Hello Tempeople!

We’re currently in the home stretch right now, as Tempopo releases in…LESS THAN A WEEK!

….and we can’t wait to hear what you think of it when it comes out. In terms of official details, we’ll be launching on [b]April 17th at 16:00 GMT[/b] and if you’re wondering what that means for you, we’ve made a handy-dandy graphic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/0d5c237ea5c71d105ff7c2efb5c0ee5fae227759.jpg[/img]

If you had a chance to play the demo during Next Fest, you’ve got a lot to look forward to (and if you didn’t, you have even more!)

[list]
[*] [b]60 total levels[/b], across four seasons, which get progressively trickier as you play on!
[*] 60 additional [b]Challenge Levels[/b] once you complete the game—and they’re so hard that even I haven’t made it past the first one (complimentary)
[*] Got a younger player, or looking for some guard rails? You can play in [b]Adventure Mode[/b], where the solution squares are highlighted, letting you concentrate on putting the right instructions in the right spots.
[*] if you don't want any guard rails at all, you can turn on [b]Creative Mode[/b], where all instructions can be placed anywhere! This chaotic game mode favours players looking to find their own solutions without any help what so ever.
[*] [b]Beautiful music to solve puzzles by[/b], as well as the opportunity to create your own music!
[/list]
We've also been sharing more songs from the Melody Garden, so here are a few to tide you over for the next week when you can make music of your own!

[previewyoutube=eJeFO2OAQME;full][/previewyoutube]
(and here's a palate cleanser for that ;) 

[previewyoutube=fhHbxDg3hwM;full][/previewyoutube]

See you all next week! 

Emily & the Witch Beam team

notes.title: The Melody Garden - a new way to make music in Tempopo!
notes.notes:
There's one thing in Tempopo that we've been keeping up our sleeves, but couldn't wait any longer to give you a look at: [b]the Melody Garden![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/f28ebc4fef370d2cf2e3458ad64a4df5a5fc58b5.jpg[/img]

Unlocked once you complete the first season, Spring, it gives you the opportunity to compose music using any of the musical flowers that you'll collect throughout the game. Choose the type of scale (diatonic or chromatic*), set the tempo, choose the notes, and you can even mute flowers as you're playing it through if you want to set up a chorus or repeating melody. And of course, pick the season that you like the most - the instruments will shift slightly based on that as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/39dcb9a274fd9795af372a4553d89d0161b31f14.jpg[/img]

Take a look at how it works - we've set it up to what we hope is a familiar tune to some, Chappell Roan's Pink Pony Club!

[previewyoutube=n7z9ammNSbY;full][/previewyoutube]

What songs should we try next? Which ones are you most excited to make in the Melody Garden?

Cheers,
Emily and the Witch Beam team

[i]*A diatonic scale is what most people think of as a scale - C, D, E, F, etc. A chromatic scale will go up only by semitones, so C, C#, D, D#, E, etc etc.[/i]

notes.title: Revealing Tempopo & the Far From Home music video!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Whether you’re here from the PC Gaming Show, saw Tempopo at an event, or are wondering what we've been up to since releasing Unpacking, welcome!

Our new game, Tempopo, is all about solving spatial puzzles at your own pace in a bright and joyful world that dances all around you. We shared a shortened version of the reveal trailer during the PC Gaming show, and now we’re [b]incredibly excited to debut the full length Director’s Cut[/b]:

[previewyoutube=XuqjFn9P8No;full][/previewyoutube]

Tempopo is coming later in 2024, so stay connected for more news by Wishlisting and Following us here on Steam. You can also join the Tempopo newsletter and find links to all our social media on our website at https://www.tempopogame.com/



https://store.steampowered.com/app/318840


[b]About Tempopo:[/b]

[i]Hana’s garden of musical flowers have been scattered across the sky and only the magical Tempopo with their unique abilities can rescue them. Mischievous and uncoordinated by nature, the Tempopo rely on Hana’s conducting skills to work together and solve each island's puzzle.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/c57df18337c1216399d7a137daf92e44ef74f144.gif[/img]

Each island begins with a planning phase in which you lay down instructions for the Tempopo to follow when you start the music. Use your wits or trial and error to find the perfect configuration, solving puzzles with inventive solutions involving multiple Tempopo performing different roles.

Take your time and enjoy the harmonious or hilarious results of your decisions, just watch out for that chomper guy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053652/a96f68f5f32509bd0890519e10e2ece3244e0467.gif[/img]

We hope you love this music video as much as we do, we'll have much more to share soon!

[i]- Witch Beam[/i]
